title: Removing a member fails silently
where: /admin/lists/<id>, Remove on a member row (from code, not clicked: production)
what_happens: RemoveMemberButton only refreshes when res.ok; on failure the label just goes back to "Remove" with no message. Not tried in a browser: clicking it would change real data.
who_hurts: An admin thinks the number was removed, and it keeps getting invites.
suggested_fix: Show a short error line on failure, like the other list forms do with text-destructive. src/app/admin/lists/[id]/remove-member-button.tsx:18-27.
rule: established pattern: create-list-form and edit-list-form show errors
